item.summary: According to preliminary figures from the Norwegian Tax Administration (Skatteetaten) for the 2025 income year, 89,600 people reported cryptocurrency holdings, with a total reported value of NOK 24.6 billion. Skatteetaten says checks are being tightened. From 2026, businesses that offer exchange and custody of cryptocurrency are required to provide information to Skatteetaten through third-party reporting.
